mechanism: Prednisone may increase haloperidol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction while corticosteroids increase risk of extrapyramidal side effects and neuroleptic malignant syndrome; haloperidol may also increase corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for reduced haloperidol efficacy and extrapyramidal symptoms; consider haloperidol dose adjustment and increased surveillance for adverse effects; monitor blood glucose and infection risk.
